summary: Makes BlobInputStream mark/reset and limit relative to the LargeObject's initial position (lazy lo_tell/lo_tell64) and overrides skip() to seek, adding Fastpath#getServerVersionNum and LargeObject#supports64BitOffsets.

tests.evidence: Bug fix plus new skip behavior; BlobTest gains many cases, but codecov reports 11 uncovered lines (pre-9.3 lo_tell path and mark() failure path).

user_docs.evidence: No docs page covers BlobInputStream; the behavior is documented in Javadoc.

doc_comments.evidence: New public Fastpath#getServerVersionNum and skip() Javadoc added; the existing mark() Javadoc still says marking a closed stream has no effect, while mark() now logs SEVERE on a closed stream.

change_description.evidence: User-visible fix closing #3144/#3149 owes a changelog entry; description explains why and what, but its 'no extra round-trip' claim is relative to #3148 only.

performance.evidence: Claims skip speed-up (no measurement, though obvious); every stream now pays a new lo_tell round-trip on first use even when the caller (PgBlob.getBinaryStream) just seeked to a known position.

security.evidence: skip() guards overflow of absolutePosition + n; no untrusted input.

backward_compat.evidence: Adds public Fastpath#getServerVersionNum; skip() now returns n past end of object instead of the actual count read, and the first read issues an extra lo_tell.

concurrency.evidence: New state mutation stays under the existing ResourceLock; assert lock.isLocked() added in getLo().

error_model.evidence: New IOException paths (initialisation failure, skip seek failure, 'BlobInputStream is closed' message fix) and mark() swallowing the IOException.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial position/limit/buffer arithmetic in skip() and lazy init; checked against PgBlob.getBinaryStream(pos,length) which passes a length, so relative limit keeps prior semantics.

user_value.evidence: Fixes two long-standing issues; the API is the standard InputStream one.

surprising_behavior.evidence: skip() past the end returns the requested count rather than the bytes available, and mark() on a closed stream now logs at SEVERE instead of doing nothing.

contradictions.evidence: mark() Javadoc ('Marking a closed stream should not have any effect') contradicts the new SEVERE log; description says older servers pay no extra round-trip while all servers now pay a lo_tell per stream.

observability.evidence: New LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, 'Failed to set mark position') in mark(): SEVERE is too loud for a closed-stream mark that the contract says is a no-op.

spec_conformance.evidence: InputStream.skip/mark/reset contracts are followed; skip past EOF is permitted by the JDK contract.

plan.why: Stream-position logic and its behavioral compatibility need a focused pass separate from the error/logging and documentation consistency checks.
